description:
Adding new features and maintaining the current student portal that is used for checking class schedules, grades, etc.

Adding new features and helping to maintain the main school website

This will be a hands on development role, but the majority of your 
time will be focused on building out in the middle-tier, back-end.

Ability to work independently and/or collaboratively within a 
diverse team environment to clearly communicate alternatives and advise 
on preferred solutions.

Requirements


5+ years of hands on software development experience

Experience with VB.Net

Experience with C#

Experience with crystal reports

Experience with desktop as well as web development

Open to travel around the Los Angeles and Orange County areas

Pluses


Experience with VB6

Experience with newer JavaScript frameworks: Angular.JS, React.JS, Ember.JS


 Skill   VB.NET, VB6, crystal reports, sql


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
